# Manipulation schemas
{: .no_toc}

Type-specific details of manipulations applied during a session.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## How to use this family

- [`manipulation`](/api/modules/manipulation/): set `type` to a type code below and send its properties in `details`.
- [`manipulationtemplate`](/api/modules/manipulationtemplate/): set `type` to a type code below and send its properties in `details`.
- Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Manipulation/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Manipulation/<Type>.json` is the current version and `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Manipulation/<Type>/` lists the versions. See [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).
- Quantities are objects `{"value": <number>, "unit": "<code>"}`. Property paths with `[]` are inside a repeatable list of rows. The server sets the schema version field itself.

## Electrical and Magnetic Stimulation

### Deep brain stimulation (DBS)

- type code `DeepBrainStimulation` · version 2.0.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Manipulation/DeepBrainStimulation/2.0.2.json)

Electrical stimulation delivered through an implanted electrode to a defined deep target. Use this rather than Electrical stimulation when the defining feature is the chronic deep-target implant.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `amplitude` | Amplitude | quantity with unit |  | units `A`, `mA`, `µA`, `nA`; default `{"unit": "A"}` | The intensity of the electrical stimulus applied, measured in amperes. |
| `duration` | Duration | quantity with unit |  | units `s`, `ms`, `µs`, `min`, `h`; default `{"unit": "s"}` | The length of time each stimulation lasts. |
| `profile` | Profile | choice |  | one of `amplitude_modulated`, `alternating_current`, `biphasic`, `burst`, `chirp`, `direct_current`, `cosine`, `frequency_hopping`, `frequency_modulated`, `decaying_exponential`, `gaussian_pulse`, `harmonic_stimulation`, `gaussian_noise`, `pseudo_random_binary_sequence`, `pink_noise`, `pulse_train`, `sawtooth`, `staircase`, `sine_wave`, `sinc_pulse`, `square`, `stochastic`, `step_function`, `ramp`, `rising_exponential`, `trapezoidal_pulse`, `triangle`, `variable_rate_pulse_train`, `white_noise` | Defines the profile of the electrical signal used for stimulation. |
| `dutyCycle` | Duty cycle | number |  | ≥ 0 | The proportion of the 'on' time to the total cycle time, expressed as a fraction. |
| `repetitions` | Repetitions | integer |  | ≥ 0 | The number of times the stimulation cycle is repeated during a session. |
| `injectionPolarity` | Injection polarity | text |  |  | Specifies the polarity of the stimulation, which can be anodal or cathodal, influencing the direction of the current flow. |
| `closedLoop` | Closed loop | yes/no |  |  | Indicates whether the stimulation system is capable of adjusting its parameters based on real-time feedback from the patient's physiological responses. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
[
    {
        "amplitude": {
            "value": 1,
            "unit": "A"
        },
        "duration": {
            "value": 1,
            "unit": "s"
        }
    }
]
```

- `interfaces` accepts ExperimentalInterface types: [`SiliconProbe`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#silicon-probe), [`Tetrode`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#tetrode), [`SingleWireElectrode`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#single-wire-electrode), [`StimulatingElectrode`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#stimulating-electrode), [`ReferenceElectrode`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#reference-electrode), [`Generic`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#generic-interface); other values are refused (400).

## Optical, Thermal and Ultrasound Stimulation

### Optogenetic stimulation

- type code `OptogeneticStimulation` · version 2.0.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Manipulation/OptogeneticStimulation/2.0.2.json)

Light delivered to drive or suppress genetically targeted cells. Record the wavelength, since it is what distinguishes excitation from inhibition for most opsins.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `power` | Power | quantity with unit |  | units `W`, `mW`, `µW`; default `{"unit": "mW"}` | The output power of the light source used for stimulation. |
| `profile` | Profile | choice |  | one of `amplitude_modulated`, `alternating_current`, `biphasic`, `burst`, `chirp`, `direct_current`, `cosine`, `frequency_hopping`, `frequency_modulated`, `decaying_exponential`, `gaussian_pulse`, `harmonic_stimulation`, `gaussian_noise`, `pseudo_random_binary_sequence`, `pink_noise`, `pulse_train`, `sawtooth`, `staircase`, `sine_wave`, `sinc_pulse`, `square`, `stochastic`, `step_function`, `ramp`, `rising_exponential`, `trapezoidal_pulse`, `triangle`, `variable_rate_pulse_train`, `white_noise` | The pattern or waveform of the light used during stimulation. |
| `duration` | Duration | quantity with unit |  | units `s`, `ms`, `µs`, `min`, `h`; default `{"unit": "s"}` | The length of time each light stimulation lasts. |
| `dutyCycle` | Duty cycle | number |  | ≥ 0 | The fraction of one period in which a signal or system is active. |
| `repetitions` | Repetitions | integer |  | ≥ 0 | The number of times the stimulation is repeated. |
| `wavelength` | Wavelength | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "nm"}` | The wavelength of the light used, selected based on the activation spectrum of the specific optogenetic actuators used. |
| `closedLoop` | Closed loop | yes/no |  |  | Indicates whether the stimulation parameters can be automatically adjusted based on feedback. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
[
    {
        "power": {
            "value": 1,
            "unit": "mW"
        },
        "profile": "amplitude_modulated"
    }
]
```

- `interfaces` accepts ExperimentalInterface types: [`SiliconProbe`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#silicon-probe), [`GRINLens`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#grin-lens), [`Prism`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#prism), [`OpticFiber`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#optic-fiber), [`Generic`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#generic-interface), [`CranialWindow`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#cranial-window), [`MicroscopeObjective`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#microscope-objective), [`Catheter`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#catheter), [`LEDArray`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#led-array); other values are refused (400).
